gen-eater-gf-anek-malayalam: Dark and jagged up top, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its ascenders short. Anek Malayalam then carries the text in a clean, contemporary sans-serif, and its curves stay open enough to read smoothly down a long page.
gen-eater-gf-anek-odia: Aggressive is the first word for Eater, whose thin strokes stay sturdy beside moderately weighty stems, while Anek Odia keeps its rounds open like an unlatched hook. Eater hits hard; the sans simply reads.
gen-eater-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big, round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes under the snarl of Eater's display heading. Its modern sans-serif lines move easily across a long page.
gen-eater-gf-anek-telugu:
Approachable text sits beneath a dark heading here.

Eater's tempered stroke modulation looks sharp and a bit menacing beside Anek Telugu, whose wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds make the sans-serif feel open and friendly.
gen-eater-gf-anuphan: Hairline-free thin strokes give Eater a gnarled look, though its joins thin gently without turning spindly. Anuphan follows in a neutral sans-serif whose big round bowls keep a long page flowing.
gen-eater-gf-arimo: Arimo sets a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded letters, a plain sans against the wide-spaced menace of Eater. Over a long passage it stays easy and unobtrusive.
gen-eater-gf-armata: Eater's wide letter gaps and short ascenders give it a dark, aggressive swagger, with only a modest gap in weight between stems and hairlines. Armata answers in a plain sans that fills most of its letter height.
gen-eater-gf-athiti: Dark, hairline-free strokes and wide gaps give Eater a snarl up top. And Athiti, a plain sans with see-through s shapes and a high mean line, can take body sizes comfortably smaller than the heading.
gen-eater-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible is a sans with clipped capitals and wide-set s terminals, set against the sturdy hairlines of Eater. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps a long passage clear and approachable while the heading growls.
gen-eater-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono: Eater is dark and aggressive, with mid-level stroke contrast and short ascenders that crouch over wide letter gaps. But Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a plain sans, opens its counters and stretches its spacing, so a long passage breathes.
